findings.evidence: Lines 187–191 use finite dimensionality only to invert `B.toDual`. Nondegeneracy and independence of `u,v` imply independence of `B(u,-),B(v,-)`, so the evaluation map has no nonzero annihilating functional and hence has full range in finite-dimensional `K²`. Thus a preimage of `(1,1)` exists without surjectivity onto the entire dual.
findings.fix: Prove the one-step lemma without ambient finite dimensionality by showing `w ↦ ![polar Q u w, polar Q v w]` surjects onto `K²`; retain the other hypotheses and propagate the generalized signature through both subsequent results.
findings.issue: Remove `[FiniteDimensional K V]` from `exists_mem_elementaryOrthogonalGroup_apply_eq_of_linearIndependent`, the private helper at line 199, and the main theorem at line 249. This assumption unnecessarily excludes infinite-dimensional nondegenerate quadratic spaces.

summary: The field results unnecessarily require the ambient space to be finite dimensional; only interpolation against two independent vectors is needed.
